latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editor Highlight Cover skill.
- Enables instant AI-generated highlight cover videos from uploaded MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB).
- Users can describe desired edits; AI handles highlight extraction and video creation in 1–2 minutes.
- Session management, status updates, and cloud GPU rendering are all automated.
- Supports uploads, exports, credits checking, and multiple common video workflows directly via user prompts.
- Error handling and onboarding for both anonymous and registered users included.
